name: emaillove-migration-audit
description: Audit an existing Figma design system for migration to Email Love: read-only module inventory with a verdict per module, source fidelity classification, scale-factor detection where it applies, spacing-system census (one system per role, not per-module ad hoc values), type-ramp census (every distinct family/size/weight/line-height tuple in the file, not what was sampled in content modules), brand foundations including the source's content margin and content width, and an effort estimate
